pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: Wyoming electrician licensing is administered through the Wyoming Department of Fire Prevention and Electrical Safety. The state licenses electrical workers at the journeyman and master levels, and candidates must follow the current Wyoming electrical licensing process before receiving a journeyman electrician license. The Wyoming Journeyman Electrician exam is commonly listed as the Wyoming 385 Journeyman Electrician examination. The exam is open book and includes 80 questions with a 4-hour time allowance. Candidates must earn a passing score of 70%. The exam is based on the National Electrical Code edition adopted for Wyoming electrical testing and includes questions related to trade knowledge and electrical code application. Major journeyman electrician exam categories include general knowledge, services and service equipment, feeders, branch circuits and conductors, wiring methods and materials, equipment and devices, control devices, motors and generators, and special occupancies, equipment, and conditions.

pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: These subjects require a combination of electrical theory, code familiarity, calculation skill, and practical understanding of electrical installations. Because the Wyoming exam is open book, preparation should include repeated practice with the code book and approved reference materials. Candidates should be comfortable finding articles, reading tables, applying definitions, reviewing exceptions, and recognizing how a code rule applies to the question being asked. The included study guides, calculations guide, flash cards, tabbed code book, and online test success kit are designed to support that type of preparation.

pieces.h: Open Book Test
pieces.t: The Wyoming Journeyman Electrician exam is an open-book exam. Open-book testing does not mean candidates can rely on the code book alone. It means candidates must know how to locate the right information quickly, read the rule carefully, and apply it correctly under time pressure. A candidate who has not practiced code navigation may spend too much time searching and not enough time answering. The official Wyoming journeyman electrician exam references have included the National Electrical Code and Ugly’s Electrical References. Candidates should bring only the references allowed for their specific exam appointment and should prepare those references according to the current exam-room rules. Code books and references should be clean, organized, and ready for use before test day. The National Electrical Code 2026 Paperback with Tabs included in this Ultimate Combo helps candidates develop the habit of working directly with the code. pieces.h: Q: Who administers the Wyoming Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Wyoming electrical contractor/trades examinations are administered through the ICC contractor/trades examination program and delivered through Pearson VUE after licensing agency approval.

pieces.h: Q: Do I need approval before scheduling the Wyoming Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Yes. Candidates must first apply with the Wyoming Department of Fire Prevention and Electrical Safety. After approval, the candidate may schedule the examination.

pieces.h: Q: What topics are covered on the Wyoming Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The exam outline includes general knowledge, electrical theory, load calculations, code definitions, plan reading, services, feeders, branch circuits, conductors, overcurrent protection, wiring methods, equipment, controls, motors, generators, special occupancies, emergency systems, signaling systems, and fire alarm systems.

pieces.h: Q: Why is the Electrician Calculations Study Guide included?
pieces.t: The calculations guide helps students practice formulas, load calculations, service and feeder work, conductor sizing, branch-circuit calculations, motor calculations, and other math-based electrical exam preparation topics.

pieces.h: Q: Why is the National Electrical Code 2026 paperback included?
pieces.t: The NEC 2026 paperback supports current-code study, code navigation practice, article review, definitions, tables, wiring methods, grounding and bonding, services, feeders, branch circuits, and electrical reference familiarity.

pieces.h: Q: What NEC edition does Wyoming currently list for examinations?
pieces.t: Wyoming licensing information states that examinations are based on the current edition of the National Electrical Code, and the current ICC Wyoming electrical bulletin lists the 2023 National Electrical Code as the exam reference.

pieces.h: Q: Can I look up every answer during the open-book exam?
pieces.t: The ICC bulletin explains that time limits make it unrealistic to look up every answer. Candidates should be familiar with their references before exam day.

pieces.h: Q: How should I study with this combo?
pieces.t: Use the Wyoming Master Electrician Study Guide to organize exam topics, the Electrician Calculations Study Guide to practice math-based problems, and the NEC 2026 paperback to strengthen code navigation skills.

pieces.h: Exam Room Approved Books
pieces.t:
National Electrical Code
Allowed in the examination room for the Wyoming Master Electrician exam. Candidates should use the exact NEC edition required by the Wyoming licensing agency and exam provider for the scheduled exam.
Ugly’s Electrical References, George V. Hart
Allowed in the examination room for formulas, tables, conversions, symbols, and calculation support.
Ferm’s Fast Finder Index
Allowed in the examination room as an NEC index tool.
National Electrical Code Handbook
Allowed in the examination room as a copy of the NEC. Candidates should remember that the exam is based only on code provisions.
Tom Henry’s Key Word Index
Allowed in the examination room as a keyword index for faster NEC navigation.

pieces.h: Q: Who is this Wyoming Master Electrician exam prep combo for?
pieces.t: This combo is for electricians preparing for the Wyoming Master Electrician exam who want NEC-based review, practice exams, full final exams, flash card support, and a structured study plan.

pieces.h: Q: Is this product based on the 2026 National Electrical Code?
pieces.t: Yes. This product is based on the 2026 National Electrical Code and is designed to support NEC-focused electrical exam preparation.

pieces.h: Q: Who regulates Wyoming Master Electrician licensing?
pieces.t: Wyoming Master Electrician licensing is administered by the Department of Fire Prevention and Electrical Safety through the Wyoming State Fire Marshal’s Office.

pieces.h: Q: What references are allowed for the Wyoming Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Approved references include the National Electrical Code, Ugly’s Electrical References, Ferm’s Fast Finder Index, National Electrical Code Handbook, and Tom Henry’s Key Word Index.

pieces.h: Q: What experience is required for the Wyoming Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Wyoming requires 8 years, or 16,000 hours, of work experience in the electrical wiring industry, including 4 years, or 8,000 hours, documented as a licensed journeyman.

pieces.h: Q: Does Wyoming require classroom instruction for the Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Yes. Wyoming requires 576 hours of electrically related classroom instruction from approved apprenticeship training programs unless an approved education exemption applies.

pieces.h: Q: How often does the Wyoming Master Electrician license renew?
pieces.t: The Wyoming Master Electrician license is valid for 3 years and renews on July 1 of every third year.

pieces.h: Q: Does Wyoming require continuing education for Master Electrician renewal?
pieces.t: Yes. Wyoming requires 16 hours of approved update education before renewal, including at least 8 hours from a course that specifically covers the National Electrical Code.

pieces.h: Q: Does this product include practice exams?
pieces.t: Yes. This package includes 12 practice exams plus 2 full final exams. The practice exams help you build familiarity with exam-style questions, while the final exams help you evaluate readiness after completing more of your study plan.

pieces.h: Q: Are flash cards included?
pieces.t: Yes. This is a study guide and flash card combo. The flash cards are designed to help reinforce electrical terms, formulas, definitions, NEC concepts, Wyoming licensing topics, calculations, and exam-style recall.

pieces.h: Q: Does this combo guarantee that I will pass the exam?
pieces.t: No. This product is designed to support preparation through structured study, practice exams, final exams, flash card review, reference navigation, and NEC-based preparation. Exam results and licensing approval depend on the candidate’s preparation, testing performance, and Wyoming licensing requirements.
